# Communal Platform API

API documentation for the Communal platform. This document describes version 2026-08-25.

Optionally send the `X-Api-Version` (or `Api-Version`) header with a supported date version. When omitted, the server uses the default version (2026-08-25). Supported versions: 2026-02-01, 2026-03-25, 2026-08-25.

Version-specific docs: `/docs/api/{version}` (e.g. `/docs/api/2026-03-25`).

Version: 2026-08-25

## Servers

- **Local**: http://api.community-management.test/api
- **Staging**: https://api.communitymanagement.xyz/api
- **Prod**: https://api.getcommunal.com/api

## Authentication

- **http**: http (bearer)

## Endpoints

### Activity

#### GET /activities/card-deliveries

List all digital member card delivery activities

**Parameters:**

- `filter[member_id]` (query) - Filter activities by the member ID belonging to the related user. Accepts alphanumeric strings.
- `filter[request_hash]` (query) - Filter activities by the unique request hash for tracing API requests.
- `filter[date_from]` (query) - Return activities created on or after the provided date. Format: ISO 8601 date/datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).
- `filter[date_to]` (query) - Return activities created on or before the provided date. Format: ISO 8601 date/datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).
- `filter[status]` (query) - Filter activities by delivery status. Supported values: `success`, `failed`.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`:

### Booking

#### GET /bookings

List bookings
Paginated facility bookings for the current organization. Members see
their own bookings; managers see all bookings. Nested write, export, and
search routes on this controller stay undocumented.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by owning user id. Members are limited to their own bookings regardless of this value.
- `filter[bookable_entity]` (query) - Filter by facility (bookable entity) id(s), including child facilities of a parent. Comma-separated for multiple.
- `filter[id]` (query) - Filter by exact booking id(s), comma-separated.
- `filter[recurring_id]` (query) - Filter by the recurring series id.
- `filter[uuid]` (query) - Filter by exact booking uuid.
- `filter[starting_at]` (query) - Filter to bookings that start on or after this date/time.
- `filter[ending_at]` (query) - Filter to bookings that end on or before this date/time.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search bookings by owner name or email, facility name, or booking id.
- `filter[associated_booking_id]` (query) - Filter by the parent booking id for linked/child bookings. Pass an empty value to match bookings with no parent.
- `filter[only_recurring]` (query) - When true, only bookings that belong to a recurring series.
- `filter[tags]` (query) - Filter by tag name(s), comma-separated.
- `filter[with_product]` (query) - Filter to bookings associated with the given product id.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: user, guest, bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, associatedBooking, organization, bookingItems, tags, formSubmissions, recurringBooking, facilities, bookingContactDetails, products.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options include readable_start_time, readable_end_time, owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, invoices_paid, total_amount_of_invoices, participants.
- `sort` (query) - Sort field. Options: id, starting_at, ending_at. Prefix with - for descending.
- `page[number]` (query) - Page number for pagination.
- `page[size]` (query) - Number of results per page.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 
- `500`: 

#### GET /bookings/{booking}

Get a booking
Returns a single facility booking, scoped to the current tenant.

**Parameters:**

- `booking` (path) (required)
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, bookableEntity.parent.form, bookableEntity.form, notes, organization, tags, user, guest, formSubmissions, facilities, bookingItems, bookingContactDetails, recurringBooking, products, invoices.transactions.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options include combined_notes, owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, participants, facilities_with_cost, created_by.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `403`: 

### Booking Request

#### GET /booking_requests

List booking requests
Paginated booking requests for the current tenant. Members see their own
requests; facility managers and super admins see the full list. The
default row is a curated payload (schedule, cost, owner, facility, state).
Pass `include` / `append` for the richer relations the product UI uses.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[query]` (query) - Search by owner name, facility name, or organization name.
- `filter[bookable_entity_id]` (query) - Filter by bookable entity id(s). Also matches child facilities of a parent entity. Comma-separated.
- `filter[booking_state_id]` (query) - Filter by booking state id(s). Comma-separated. Include the declined sentinel to also return declined requests.
- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by owning member id. Non-managers may only use their own id.
- `filter[starting_at]` (query) - Filter to requests that start on or after this datetime.
- `filter[ending_at]` (query) - Filter to requests that end on or before this datetime.
- `filter[uuid]` (query) - Look up a single request by its public uuid.
- `filter[recurring_id]` (query) - Filter to requests in a recurring series.
- `filter[tags]` (query) - Filter by tag name(s). Comma-separated.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, bookableEntity.form, guest, user, bookingState, transaction, organization, bookingItems, tags, bookingContactDetails, recurringBooking, formSubmissions, files, notes, facilities.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, invoices_paid, total_amount_of_invoices, combined_notes, associated_recurring_ids, flat_total_for_user_and_availability, next_state, previous_state, participant_name (facility managers and super admins only).
- `sort` (query) - Sort by id, starting_at, or ending_at. Prefix with - for descending.
- `page[number]` (query) - Page number for pagination.
- `page[size]` (query) - Number of results per page.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `BookingRequestResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /booking_requests/{booking_request}

Get a booking request
Returns a single booking request. Members may only view their own;
facility managers and super admins may view any request in the tenant.

**Parameters:**

- `booking_request` (path) (required)
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, bookableEntity.form, guest, user, bookingState, transaction, files, notes, organization, recurringBooking, tags, formSubmissions, formSubmissions.form, bookingContactDetails, bookingItems, facilities.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: remaining_recurring_bookings, combined_notes, owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, created_by, facilities_with_cost, next_state, previous_state, participant_name (facility managers and super admins only).
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: `BookingRequestResource`
- `401`: 
- `404`:

### Facility

#### GET /facilities

List facilities
Returns a paginated list of the spaces and resources members can book,
with their booking rules and membership requirements. Filter by booking
type, parent facility, archived state, or a free-text name search.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[type]` (query)
- `filter[parent_id]` (query)
- `filter[status]` (query)
- `filter[query]` (query)
- `include` (query)
- `page[number]` (query)
- `page[size]` (query)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `FacilityResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### POST /facilities

Create a facility
Creates a facility from name, description, and optional booking type, capacity, scheduling settings, visibility, and booking-form options. Other fields are ignored. Defaults to hidden from the public with public booking disabled and manager-only booking. API keys require facilities:write; session users require a facility manager or organization administrator role.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

- `publicly_exposed` (boolean)
- `publicly_exposed_allow_bookings` (boolean)
- `manager_only` (boolean)
- `type` (string)
- `capacity` (integer,null)
- `booking_interval` (integer)
- `future_days` (integer)
- `basis_time` (string)
- `booking_request_deadline` (integer,null)
- `publicly_exposed_hide_user_names` (boolean)
- `prompt_for_booking_owner` (boolean)
- `prompt_for_adding_more_users` (boolean)
- `prompt_for_number_of_guests` (boolean)
- `user_recurring_bookings` (boolean)
- `user_specified_reason` (boolean)
- `name` (string)
- `description` (string)

**Responses:**

- `201`: `FacilityResource`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`: 

#### GET /facilities/{facility}

Get a facility
Returns a single space or resource with its booking rules and membership

**Parameters:**

**Responses:**

- `403`: 
- `422`: 

### Membership Card

#### POST /membership_cards/send

Send a membership card for a user
Sends a membership card via the email on file for the user. This method allows
configuration of which card types to send.

This endpoint can also be used to create
and update user specific data that will be used to generate the card. If an email supplied
is not found, a new user will be created with the additional data supplied.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

- `card_types` (array)
- `user` (object) - User specific data that will stored on the user profile and used to generate the card. If not supplied during
this request, the data stored on the user profile will be used.

**Responses:**

- `200`: 
- `401`: 
- `422`:

### Program

#### GET /parent_programs/options

List programs as slim dropdown options
Purpose-built for filter dropdowns that need every program for the
tenant: paginates in SQL, selects only the columns an option list
renders, and serializes no relations (tags, registration opportunities,
occurrences). Prefer this over index() for pickers.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `ParentProgramOptionResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /parent_programs

List programs
Returns a paginated list of programs. Registration opportunities (sessions) are
excluded by default for performance - use `?include=programs` to include them.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `Program`
- `401`: 

#### POST /parent_programs

Create program
Create a top-level program. Requires the parent-programs:create API key scope and a Program Manager or Super Admin role. Programs default to draft; an omitted, null, or blank title defaults to New Program. Registration opportunities, schedules, and prices are not created.

**Parameters:**

- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

- `title` (string,null)
- `description` (string,null)
- `ongoing` (boolean,null)
- `event_start_date` (string,null)
- `event_end_date` (string,null)
- `profile_image` (string,null)
- `location_name` (string,null)
- `location_address` (string,null)
- `location_latitude` (number,null)
- `location_longitude` (number,null)
- `pay_by_cash` (boolean,null)
- `collection_additional_information` (boolean,null)
- `require_emergency_contact_information` (boolean,null)
- `waitlist_enabled` (boolean,null)
- `prompt_for_registrant` (boolean,null)
- `unsplash_author_name` (string,null)
- `unsplash_author_link` (string,null)
- `demographic` (string,null)
- `instructor` (string,null)
- `force_participant_selection` (boolean,null)
- `display_only` (boolean,null)
- `draft` (boolean,null)
- `registration_fee` (number,null)
- `cap_registration_fee` (boolean,null)
- `is_event` (boolean,null)
- `multiple_signups` (boolean,null)
- `is_hidden` (boolean,null)
- `show_participant_list` (boolean,null)
- `hide_participant_details` (boolean,null)
- `total_spots` (integer,null)
- `allow_file_uploads` (boolean,null)
- `file_uploads_required` (boolean,null)
- `file_uploads_max` (integer,null)
- `auto_archive` (boolean,null)
- `auto_archive_days` (integer,null)
- `participant_must_hold_membership` (boolean,null)
- `gl_code` (string,null)

**Responses:**

- `200`: `ParentProgram`
- `401`: 
- `403`: 
- `422`:

### Program Signup

#### GET /program_signups

List program signups

**Parameters:**

- `filter[program_id]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity ID. Supports comma-separated values for multiple registration opportunities.
- `filter[program[parent_program_id]]` (query) - Filter by program ID. Returns signups for all registration opportunities under this program.
- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by user ID. Non-managers can only filter to their own ID.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search by registration opportunity name, user name, user email, guest name, additional member name, or guest email.
- `filter[status]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity time status. Supports multiple comma-separated values. Options: ongoing, upcoming, past.
- `filter[signup_status]` (query) - Manager-only signup lifecycle filter. Options: active, cancelled, cancelled:member, cancelled:admin. Defaults to active.
- `filter[timeScope]` (query) - Simple time scope filter. Options: upcoming (includes ongoing and active), past, all.
- `filter[event_start_date]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity event date range. Pass as array: filter[event_start_date][0]=start&filter[event_start_date][1]=end. Includes ongoing registration opportunities.
- `filter[upcoming]` (query) - Filter to signups for upcoming registration opportunities only.
- `filter[past]` (query) - Filter to signups for past registration opportunities only.
- `filter[ongoing]` (query) - Filter to signups for ongoing registration opportunities only.
- `filter[withTrashed]` (query) - Include soft-deleted signups. Defaults to excluding deleted.
- `filter[program[archived_at]]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity archived status. Pass empty string to exclude archived registration opportunities.
- `filter[program[deleted_at]]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity deleted status. Pass empty string to exclude deleted registration opportunities.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: additionalMember, additionalMember.emergency, files, guest, program, program.parentProgram, transaction, user, user.family, user.family.emergency, formSubmissions, subscriptionSchedule.config.configurable, subscriptionSchedule.paymentsReceived, attendanceRecords.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `ProgramSignupResource`
- `401`:

Options: additionalMember, additionalMember.emergency, files, guest, program, program.parentProgram, transaction, user, user.family, user.family.emergency, formSubmissions, subscriptionSchedule.config.configurable, subscriptionSchedule.paymentsReceived, attendanceRecords.

### Registration Opportunity

#### GET /programs/options

List registration opportunities as slim dropdown options
Purpose-built for filter dropdowns that need every registration
opportunity for the tenant: paginates in SQL, selects only the columns
an option list renders, and serializes no relations or computed
pricing attributes. Prefer this over index() for pickers.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[parent_program_id]` (query) - Filter to registration opportunities under this program.
- `filter[archived_at]` (query) - Filter by archived status. Pass empty string to exclude archived registration opportunities.
- `filter[deleted_at]` (query) - Filter by deleted status. Pass empty string to exclude deleted registration opportunities.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search registration opportunities by name (partial match).
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `RegistrationOpportunityOptionResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /programs

List registration opportunities
Returns a paginated list of registration opportunities with optional filtering.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[parent_program_id]` (query) - Filter by program ID.
- `filter[status]` (query) - Filter by status. Supports multiple comma-separated values. Options: active, upcoming, past, ongoing, archived.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search registration opportunities by name (partial match).
- `filter[with_participants]` (query) - Filter to only registration opportunities that have participants.
- `filter[can_register]` (query) - Filter to only registration opportunities the authenticated user can register for.
- `filter[upcoming]` (query) - Filter to only upcoming registration opportunities.
- `filter[past]` (query) - Filter to only past registration opportunities.
- `filter[archived_at]` (query) - Filter by archived status. Pass empty string to exclude archived registration opportunities.
- `filter[deleted_at]` (query) - Filter by deleted status. Pass empty string to exclude deleted registration opportunities.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: signups, parentProgram, waitlistSignups, attendanceSheets, occurrences.
- `append` (query) - Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options: audience, signup_count.
- `sort` (query) - Sort results by field. Prefix with - for descending. Options: id, registration_start_date, registration_end_date, event_start_date, event_end_date, created_at.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `RegistrationOpportunityResource`
- `401`:

### Transaction

#### GET /transactions

List transactions
Paginated, filterable, and sortable transaction ledger for reporting and
managed-API-key consumers. Every row is scoped to the current tenant.

**Parameters:**

- `filter[range]` (query) - Filter to transactions whose effective date falls between two dates. Pass as comma-separated start,end (or an array): filter[range]=2025-01-01,2025-01-31.
- `filter[starting_at]` (query) - Filter to transactions with an effective date on or after this date.
- `filter[ending_at]` (query) - Filter to transactions with an effective date on or before this date (end of day).
- `filter[type]` (query) - Filter by transaction type. Supports comma-separated values. Options: membership, program, charge, invoice, donation, booking, refund, transfer. Each option (other than refund) matches both the charge and its refund type.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search transactions by related user/guest/account name or email, or by program signup id (subscription schedule lookup).
- `filter[membership_type_id]` (query) - Filter to transactions for the given membership type (plan product) id.
- `filter[amount]` (query) - Filter by amount in dollars. Pass a bare value for an exact match, or prefix with lte: / gte: for a range bound.
- `filter[id]` (query) - Filter by exact transaction id. Supports comma-separated values.
- `filter[payout_id]` (query) - Filter by exact payout id.
- `filter[subscription_schedule_id]` (query) - Filter by the local subscription schedule id (transactions.subscription_schedule_id). This is not the Stripe `sub_sched_...` id, which lives on subscription_schedules.stripe_schedule_id.
- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by exact owning user id.
- `filter[promotion_code_id]` (query) - Filter by exact promotion code id.
- `filter[tags]` (query) - Filter by tag name(s). Supports comma-separated values.
- `filter[with_product]` (query) - Filter to transactions associated with the given product (membership/plan) id. Takes a product id, not a boolean — it matches both transaction line items and invoice items for that product.
- `filter[with_parent_program]` (query) - Filter to transactions associated with the given parent program id(s), including the refunds of those charges. Takes parent program id(s), not a boolean. Supports comma-separated values.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Only these two options visibly change the response; every other loadable relation is already eager-loaded and always present. Options: tags (adds the `tags` field), invoice.bookings.bookableEntity (populates `bookable_entity` inside `invoice.bookings`).
- `sort` (query) - Sort by effective date (falls back to created_at). Options: -created_at (descending) or created_at (ascending).
- `page[number]` (query) - Page number for pagination.
- `page[size]` (query) - Number of results per page.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: Paginated set of `TransactionResource`
- `401`: 

#### GET /transactions/{transaction}

Get a transaction
Returns a single transaction, scoped to the current tenant. Relations
are always eager-loaded to match the fields the resource can return
(e.g. invoice, associated_transaction, promotion_code); unlike the
index endpoint, this endpoint does not accept `include` or `append`.
The `tags` field is only ever populated via `include=tags` on the index
endpoint, so it is never present in this response.

**Parameters:**

- `transaction` (path) (required)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Responses:**

- `200`: `TransactionResource`
- `401`: 
- `404`:

#### PUT /users/{user}

Update a user
Performs an user update request.

**Parameters:**

- `user` (path) (required)
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-08-25.

**Request Body:**

Content-Type: `application/json`

- `name` (string,null) - The full name of the user (generated from first/last name).
- `first_name` (string) - The first name of the user.
- `last_name` (string) - The last name of the user.
- `middle_name` (string,null) - The middle name of the user.
- `preferred_name` (string,null) - The preferred name of the user.
- `date_of_birth` (string,null) - The date of birth of the user.
- `email` (string) - A unique email address for the user.
- `profile_city` (string,null) - The city of the user.
- `profile_zip` (string,null) - The postal code or zip code of the user.
- `profile_state` (string,null) - The province or state of the user.
- `profile_address` (string,null) - The street address of the user.
- `profile_address_line_2` (string,null) - The second line of the address of the user.
- `profile_country` (string,null) - The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the user.
- `telephone` (string,null) - A phone number for the user.
- `custom_form` (object)

**Responses:**

- `200`: `User`
- `401`:
